Occurrence-indexed token binding makes five clause-flips change the experiment; first-clause abstract refusal keeps the five no-observable controls silent under condition-11/manifest injection. This is a purposive sample, not a repository-wide prevalence estimate.
report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); a generated experiment counts as usable only if it is RUN for at least 5 of the 30 and produces a discriminating result; the rest are marked GENERATED-UNRUN
tests_required_verbatim: negative control: include 5 claims that name no observable and require the generator to emit NEEDS-HUMAN-FRAMING; emitting a plausible experiment for an unobservable claim is the failure mode

generator_contract.stop_rule: If the first clause is an abstract frame with no locator, or the full text has no machine-addressable locator, emit NEEDS-HUMAN-FRAMING and no experiment.
generator_contract.usability_rule: Only RUN-DISCRIMINATING counts as empirically usable; GENERATED-UNRUN is never folded into usable.
generator_contract.bind_rule: Every load-bearing token occurrence is indexed into the experiment so omitting one occurrence changes the bound experiment.
